parties: Siddeshwari Tradex Private Limited (acquirer) and JITF Infralogistics Limited (target)
headline: Siddeshwari Tradex files substantial acquisition disclosure for JITF Infralogistics
sum: Siddeshwari Tradex Private Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in JITF Infralogistics Limited. The disclosure indicates a threshold-triggering shareholding event in the listed logistics-infrastructure company.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures are filed post-acquisition when a party crosses statutory thresholds; partners must immediately review board composition, open offer obligations under Regulation 4, and any creeping acquisition exemptions claimed.
detail: Siddeshwari Tradex Private Limited has submitted to the NSE a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandatory when an acquirer's shareholding in a listed company crosses defined thresholds (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 35%, 40%, 45%, 50%, or higher) or when concert-party arrangements alter effective control. The disclosure was filed on 22 June 2026 via NSE's corporate filing system. No open offer announcement has yet been disclosed in the sources reviewed, suggesting either a below-threshold creeping acquisition (if permitted under Regulation 5) or imminent formal takeover notice.

central; reverse book-building procedures for open offers; pricing floor tied to reference date and volume-weighted average price.
